title: Smooth-Point Certificates for Polydegree Containments: A Jacobian Interpretation of the Lewis-Perry-Straub Determinant
description: Anonymous, unrefereed candidate manuscript and exact evidence package. The paper identifies the Lewis-Perry-Straub auxiliary determinant as a Jacobian, derives an integral Euler syzygy and a sharper Hensel certificate, proves a curve bridge and uniform individual boundary squarefreeness, and records bounded exact affine and adjacent-coprimality evidence. The uniform all-d affine theorem remains open. Producer-side replay passes; independent reproduction, formal verification, external specialist review, editorial peer review and absolute priority are not claimed.
